about: What this file is: the people test's painting brief for paint_request.py (see notice-corner-brief.json), copied by the painting-tools helper (log 35) from the prompts the people test sent (film-kit/assets/models/inflation-chapter-2-newcomers/people-test/people-test-paintings.json).
place_sentence: It is a pit-village street at dusk in 1926.
set_keep: the red-brick terraces on the left with their chimney stacks
the stone houses, steps and downpipes on the right
the flagstone pavement, the kerb, the smooth stone gutter with no steps or ridges, and the sett road
colour_sentence: The road, pavement and walls are cool blue-grey dusk, and the brick is weathered and greyed by coal smoke without getting any darker.

thin_words.winding wheels: the spokes of the winding wheels
thin_words.chimney: the spokes of the winding wheels

people.dress: dark painted workers in long dark wool work coats and flat caps, in dull browns, greys and near-black, with the same ink outlines
people.behind_note: one of them bending over the drum to warm his hands, two standing by the lamp post on the right
people.near_where: in long dark coats and caps standing round the rusty drum on the pavement edge
people.remove_note: the man bending over the drum, the two men by the lamp post on the right, the man in the middle of the road and the man on the left

never_add_notes.flames: (not from the drum, not from any chimney)

behind.behind_words: the sett road, the kerb, the smooth stone gutter, the flagstone pavement, the foot of the lamp post, the stone house fronts with their windows, doorways and downpipes, the brick terraces, and the colliery's shut iron gates
behind.warm_words: the same soft warm glow on the setts and flagstones round the drum
behind.keep_words: the rusty drum with its faint orange glow inside, the houses, windows and lit windows, every gas lamp, the colliery's tall chimney, winding wheels and headgear, the colliery building with its board and shut gates, the stone steps at the bottom right, and the sky
